lines.text: After Jesus finishes praying, a disciple asks Him to teach them to pray, just as John taught his disciples.
Jesus tells them to pray to the Father, ask for bread each week, and forgive everyone who sins against them.
In Jesus' story, a man goes to his friend at midnight to borrow three loaves, but the friend says his door is shut.
Jesus says the friend gets up because of the man's fear, and tells them to ask, seek and knock.
Jesus says that if evil fathers give good gifts to their children, the Father in heaven will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask.
